batch_crop_voxels_within_box: batch crop voxels within 3D bounding boxes using camera matrices and voxel side length
create_VoxelInstances: create a VoxelInstances object from a list of PyTorch voxel tensors for batched operations
downsample_voxel_tensor: downsample a 3D voxel tensor by a factor using max or mean pooling across dimensions
verts2voxel: convert normalized 3D vertex coordinates into a binary voxel grid of a specified size
normalize_verts: normalize 3D vertex coordinates by centering and scaling to a unit bounding box
